issues: Pure true damage not consuming the first-hit reduction does not establish true-damage negation; eligible damage wording avoids that unsupported claim.
Turrets are unaffected. Damage reduction benefits only Braum and can apply beyond projectiles.

citations.quote: The first instance of damage dealt by a champion from this direction is reduced by 100%.
Unbreakable's full damage reduction can block multiple instances of damage if they're dealt at the same time.
Damage over time is calculated per tick but the full damage reduction will still only apply to a single tick.
The one-time-use full damage reduction will not be consumed if the damage source is nothing but true damage.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The detailed first-hit rule specifies champion damage. Simultaneous instances can share full reduction; damage over time normally uses it on a single tick. Pure true damage does not consume it, which does not establish that true damage is negated.

citations.quote: The damage reduction will affect any source of damage whose origin is in front of the shield.
Melee and non-projectile-based ranged attacks.

The damage reduction only benefits Braum.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Damage reduction extends beyond projectiles, including melee attacks and eligible abilities. Ground-targeted abilities use their center to determine direction. The reduction itself benefits only Braum.

citations.quote: Projectiles whose effects trigger on collision will still trigger - dealing damage, applying debuffs, creating area of effects and marking the target as 'hit'.

factual_risks: All six cards are UNAPPROVED drafts.
The Data Dragon release is pinned; no game patch label is inferred.
The prior passive visual description was removed because its exact sequence is not established by text. Demonstration frames are not current-client or skin-specific verification.
Build focus is an inferred broad learning recommendation, not an optimal build.
Wiki Arena differences and unrelated skin material are excluded.

Unbreakable has complex projectile eligibility and damage-origin rules. Interception does not imply cancellation of collision effects, immunity to crowd control or damage reduction shared with allies.
Pure true damage not consuming E's first-instance reduction does not establish that the damage is negated.
E's pure-true-damage non-consumption rule does not establish true-damage negation. The draft's eligibility qualification avoids that claim; the interaction remains a QA consideration.
E interception does not cancel collision effects or resulting areas of effect and does not grant allies Braum's damage reduction. The draft does not assert those broader protections.
The L1 build focus is a broad inference supported by the tank role, defensive resistances and Q health scaling, rather than evidence of an optimal build.
The supplied demonstration frames do not establish current-client passive visuals; no visual verification or human approval is provided by this check.
